data: Which curve in the right panel is the highest at 25 steps?

The question asks which curve in the right panel is the highest at 25 steps. From the caption, we know that the en-tr curves converged very quickly. This implies that the curves for en-tr will be closer together and have lower values compared to the en-fi curves. 

Looking at the right panel (b), the three curves are labeled as attention, K=32 sigmoid/softmax, and K=64 sigmoid/softmax. At 25 steps, the red line (attention) appears to be the highest among the three curves. Therefore, the answer is the red line.
